Why config-first beats convention-first for client work

Every client has the same five pages and 27 unique opinions about each. Config-first templates let you accommodate the 27 without rewriting the five.

Ada LovelaceFounder · Analytic Studio
Published
July 27, 2026
Category
Engineering
On this page
  • What configuration buys you

On this page

  • What configuration buys you

The dirty secret of agency work is that every site is the same site with different colors. Conventions encode the sameness; configuration captures the differences.

What configuration buys you

  • Brand theming without touching components.
  • Per-client feature flags (does this one need a blog? cookies?).
  • Faster onboarding — new contractor reads one file, ships the next day.
